versions.content: A Low-priority or same-priority request can preempt a higher priority protocol if this higher priority protocol is in default session and no active re- quest is in execution phase. In this case the DSL submodule shall call all configured Xxx_StopProtocol() functions (see configuration parameter DcmDslCallbackDCMRe- questService ).
